The lab welcomes prospective undergraduate researchers, graduate students, postdocs, and academic visitors. We work with researchers from a wide range of backgrounds — field and laboratory biologists, other quantitative biological scientists, and students and collaborators coming in from mathematics, statistics, computing, or the physical sciences.

## Prospective graduate students

If the lab's work looks like a fit:

- Look through the [Research](research.qmd) and [Software](software.qmd) pages and a few of Dan's [recent publications](publications.qmd) to find the threads that interest you most.
- Develop strong quantitative skills before you apply.
- Field- and lab-based projects may be available through co-supervision with other KU scientists.

Applications go through KU's Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology. Useful starting points:

- [KU Graduate School](https://graduate.ku.edu/)
- [EEB application page](https://eeb.ku.edu/how-apply)

**The annual application deadline is December 1.**

## Prospective postdocs and visiting researchers

Reach out to Dan directly ([reuman@ku.edu](mailto:reuman@ku.edu)) with a CV and a brief note about the work you'd like to do.
